observations.summary: A Hub id that cannot be stored appends one `send_unknown` fact per pass for as long as the route is open
observations.recommendation: Scope: instance. dispatch() keeps any string `sent.body.id` in the `hub-answer` audit row and calls bindHubId with it on every pass while the exchange has no hub_id. bindHubId returns markSendUnknown(exchangeId, 'hub-id-invalid') for an id that fails HUB_ID_RE, and `send_unknown` is not in ONCE_FACTS, so each 15-second pass appends another fact and reprojects the row until the Master answers or closes the route. The route outcome is correct (unconfirmed, not resent, Master told). It needs the Hub to answer 200 with an id outside `[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}`, and the branch has no test. A fix would be to not remember or retry an id that fails the same pattern. ACCEPT is reasonable; if fixed, ride a commit already owed.

observations.summary: The gateway's own bind records the Hub status as `received` whatever the Hub said
observations.recommendation: Scope: instance. dispatch() passes `hubStatus: 'received'` to bindHubId; the Hub's real answer (`sent.body.status`, which may be `queued`) is available on the first pass and is not kept in the `hub-answer` row for later ones. The value becomes the `hub_accepted` fact's code. No reader of that code was found in lib/medusa-exchanges.js or lib/medusa-watchdog.js, so nothing acts on it. ACCEPT.

observations.summary: The retired-recipient test sets the exchange state by a direct UPDATE
observations.recommendation: Scope: instance. 'a recipient that retires does not make an unconfirmed send sendable again' writes `state = 'recipient_retired'` on the row instead of calling markRecipientRetired, so it proves dispatch()'s branch on that state and not the producer that sets it. dispatch() reads only `exchange.state` and `hub_id` there, and no bind runs in that test, so the assertion holds for the real producer by reading. ACCEPT.

observations.summary: No test evidence on disk for the commit under review
observations.recommendation: Scope: none. `prawduct-hook test-status` exits 1 (`stale: no .test-evidence.json on disk`). The builder reports the full suite running detached in this worktree; none of the new tests was run or credited from here. It gates nothing at this stage; the boundary review will ask again.
